title: Locked Rooms
statement: A hotel has n rooms numbered 0 to n − 1. Only room 0 is unlocked. rooms[i] lists the keys found in room i; a key opens the room with that number. Return true if you can enter every room.

keyPoints: Treat rooms as vertices and keys as directed edges
Search from room 0, marking rooms entered
Return whether every room was entered
edgeCases: A room with its own key
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Repeatedly scan all rooms for usable keys: O(n · keys)

hints: Each key is an arrow from the room where it lies to the room it opens. What question is left?
Can every room be reached from room 0?
Run DFS or BFS from room 0 with a visited array, then check that all were visited.
